title: Perception Dashboard: Collate competitive signals into buyer narratives
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight Perception Dashboard and playbook that synthesizes model-landscape signals (public releases, pricing, latency probes, telemetry) into short buyer-facing narratives and tactical recommendations for PM, sales, and field teams.
context: We receive fragmented signals: public model announcements, partner pricing changes, customer procurement questions, and internal latency/cost telemetry. Field teams need concise narratives (e.g., 'Lower-latency embeddings available in APAC at 30% cheaper unit cost for short-context use cases') together with suggested product actions (e.g., promote Dedicated reserved capacity for SMBs in APAC). No single artifact currently maps signals to buyer impact and recommended playbooks.
objectives: Create a repeatable pipeline that pulls and normalizes signals from model releases, vendor pricing pages, telemetry, and regional latency probes
Surface 3 actionable buyer narratives per week with confidence tags (evidence level: anecdotal / corroborated / validated)
Provide recommended tactical plays (pricing/rollout/communication) tied to each narrative
Enable field and PM to subscribe to narrative updates and export short-ready blurbs for sales decks and release notes
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows at least 5 distinct signal sources and normalizes them into a single timeline view
Can generate a 1-paragraph buyer narrative and a 2-item tactical play for any flagged signal within 24 hours
Field team pilot (3 reps) confirms narratives are helpful in >2/3 of trial conversations
Playbook documents stored in Drive and linked from dashboard; process owner assigned
decisions: Keep initial scope to text-based narratives and regional latency/pricing signals (no embeddings quality A/B yet)
Use confidence tags (anecdotal/corroborated/validated) to qualify narratives for field distribution
Store canonical narrative artifacts in Drive with versioned filenames for auditability
next_steps: Finish v0 ETL to pull pricing and model announcement feeds (owner: Data Eng)
Prototype automatic narrative generator using prompt templates and curated evidence snippets (owner: PM)
Recruit 3 field reps for 2-week pilot and define success metrics (owner: Field)
Schedule stakeholder review 2026-03-18 to finalize playbook taxonomy
timeline: Week 1: wireframes + feed inventory. Week 2: implement ETL + basic UI. Week 3: narrative generator + pilot prep. Week 4: pilot and iterate.
